title: Count words in a span
description:
Write `public static class Words` with `public static int Count(ReadOnlySpan<char> text)` that counts words separated by any whitespace (`char.IsWhiteSpace`). Do not create strings or arrays: walk the span.

```csharp
Words.Count("  the quick\tbrown\nfox  ");   // 4
```
hints: Keep a `bool inWord`. A non-space character that arrives while you are not in a word starts a new word; a space ends the current one.
rules: Walk the span instead of calling Split, which creates an array of strings.
Work on the span directly instead of turning it into a string.
